properties.arguments: [concat('-WebhookUrl "', variables('installRegistrationWebhookUrl'), '" -InstallationId "', variables('installationId'), '" -LicenseKey "', variables('generatedLicenseKey'), '" -DeploymentTier "', parameters('deploymentTier'), '" -DeploymentTimestamp "', variables('deploymentTimestamp'), '" -SubscriptionId "', subscription().subscriptionId, '" -TenantId "', subscription().tenantId, '" -ResourceGroupId "', resourceGroup().id, '" -ResourceGroupName "', resourceGroup().name, '" -Region "', parameters('location'), '" -ManifestBlobName "', variables('manifestBlobName'), '"')]
properties.scriptContent:
param(
  [string]$WebhookUrl,
  [string]$InstallationId,
  [string]$LicenseKey,
  [string]$DeploymentTier,
  [string]$DeploymentTimestamp,
  [string]$SubscriptionId,
  [string]$TenantId,
  [string]$ResourceGroupId,
  [string]$ResourceGroupName,
  [string]$Region,
  [string]$ManifestBlobName
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$payload = @{
  installationId = $InstallationId
  licenseKey = $LicenseKey
  deploymentTier = $DeploymentTier
  deploymentTimestamp = $DeploymentTimestamp
  customerName = $env:CUSTOMER_NAME
  customerEmail = $env:CUSTOMER_EMAIL
  customerPhone = $env:CUSTOMER_PHONE
  subscriptionId = $SubscriptionId
  subscriptionName = $env:SUBSCRIPTION_NAME
  tenantId = $TenantId
  tenantName = $env:TENANT_NAME
  resourceGroupId = $ResourceGroupId
  resourceGroupName = $ResourceGroupName
  fabricCapacitySku = $env:FABRIC_CAPACITY_SKU
  region = $Region
  manifestBlobName = $ManifestBlobName
}

try {
  $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $WebhookUrl -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body ($payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress)
  Write-Output "Install registration completed for installationId: $InstallationId"
  if ($null -ne $response) {
    Write-Output ($response | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress)
  }
}
catch {
  Write-Warning "Install registration call failed but deployment will continue: $($_.Exception.Message)"
}
